notes.title: Farewell to Seal of Faith
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there![/p][p][/p][p]The [i]Seal of Faith[/i] DLC — our special feature where players could leave messages in the church’s Foliant — has been officially retired.[/p][p]
It is no longer available for purchase, and new messages can’t be added.[/p][p][/p][p]However, all notes left by players before delisting have been preserved in the final build.
Your words are sealed forever — a quiet tribute to those who believed.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of something special.[/p]

The Valley of Fallen Sinners is dressed up for the holidays! Sparkling garlands, festive cheer, and new adventures await you in our special holiday event. It’s time to celebrate the season with festive fun and exclusive rewards!

This year has been an incredible journey for us. We are beyond thrilled to bring Sin Slayers back in a new form, packed with the largest amount of content the game has ever seen. Your unwavering support has been our guiding light, and we are endlessly grateful for every moment you've shared with us. 

[i]We’d be incredibly grateful if you could take a moment to leave a review on Steam. Your feedback means the world to us and helps us improve the experience for everyone.

Defeat enemies throughout the Valley and collect Holiday Candies, a special event currency that can be traded for exclusive rewards.

notes.title: Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th – Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893926/3f830bb30d1dbd16d5d6bdf65d2ea57edb135045.jpg[/img]
ːwinter2019coolyulː [b]UNLEASH YOUR SINS, SLAYERS[/b] ːwinter2019coolyulː

Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th has officially launched on Steam bringing players back to a dark, sin-filled world, now reimagined, expanded, and more brutal than ever. This definitive roguelite RPG dares players to confront their deepest fears and sins in a relentless battle for survival.

[previewyoutube=MGLhR_AYEuw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Step Into the Sinful World of Sin Slayers[/h2]

Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th immerses players in a dark fantasy world consumed by the Eight Deadly Sins: Pride, Wrath, Greed, Envy, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, and now Faith. Each sin dominates its own unique domain, offering challenging dungeons, monstrous foes, and a climactic battle with a Sin Lord who embodies the essence of their realm.

Your journey begins with assembling a team of cursed heroes, each with unique abilities and backstories. Dive into procedurally generated dungeons, where every run tests your strategy, resourcefulness, and resolve. Engage in tactical turn-based combat, master the art of loot collection and crafting, and carefully manage your party to survive the escalating challenges of this unforgiving world.

[h3]Your Sins Shape the World[/h3]
In Sin Slayers, morality is more than a theme - it’s a mechanic. The Sin-o-Meter dynamically adjusts the game’s difficulty based on your actions. Will you play cautiously to avoid angering the world, or indulge in greed and face overwhelming odds? Every choice alters your journey, changing not only how the game plays but how the world itself responds to your presence.

[b]Core Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turn-Based Combat: Engage in deep, tactical battles against a wide variety of enemies and deadly Sin Lords, each with unique abilities and strategies.
[*] Exploration and Progression: Uncover the secrets of a dark, corrupted world while upgrading your heroes and unlocking powerful new abilities.
[*] Loot and Crafting: Collect rare loot and craft unique items to gain the edge in battle.
[*] Party Management: Balance your team of cursed heroes, utilizing their individual strengths and synergies to overcome the challenges of each dungeon.
[*] Replayability: Procedurally generated dungeons, dynamic difficulty, and endless combinations of loot and builds ensure no two runs are the same.
[/list]
[b]The Eighth Sin – Faith[/b]
For the first time, Reign of the 8th introduces a new, sinister addition to the Seven Deadly Sins: Faith. This enigmatic new Sin rules over the Factory, a haunting industrial wasteland filled with powerful enemies, dangerous traps, and rare treasures. Faith manipulates reality itself, challenging players to face illusions and question what’s real. The battle against Faith is unlike anything players have faced before.

[b]Available Now with a 40% Launch Discount[/b]
Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th is now available on Steam with a sweet launch discount and special regional pricing, making it accessible to players around the globe.

[b]Original owners of Sin Slayers[/b] can redeem a free upgrade as a thank-you for their loyalty. Claim your copy here: https://sinslayers.com/restore-purchase

Face your sins. Change your world.

Stay tuned for further news and activities by following [url=https://x.com/sinslayersgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/sinslayersgame/]Facebook [/url]and joining the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FCDAbqSs]Discord [/url]server of Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th.

This is a truly significant moment in our lives, and we’re incredibly happy to bring Sin Slayers back to you after a long journey filled with passion and perseverance. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you so much for your unwavering support. We love you, as always, Slayers!

[i]Goonswarm Team[/i]

notes.title: Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th Returns to Steam with a NEW DEMO AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Slayers![/h2]

We are excited to share a big change: we have parted ways with our publisher and are now independent. This is a major step for us and for the whole Sin Slayers community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893926/7f4559c3bb0361e9b4514c20984ed7fb4b06aaae.png[/img]

The game is back with more content, various enhancements, and a commitment to compensate all players who bought the original game, with a free game key for new and improved version. This dark and gritty RPG invites players to delve into a world shrouded in darkness and teeming with monstrous challenges, where your choices dictate the fate of your party - and the world.

[h2]What does this mean for you?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Return to Steam: Sin Slayers is coming back to Steam with new content, better gameplay, and many exciting features we will reveal soon.
[*] Content Support Restored: We will support the game on all platforms again. Expect the return of old and new seasonal events, regular bug fixes, and more exciting updates.
[*] Purchase Restoration Campaign: To show our thanks, we are launching a Purchase Restoration Campaign. If you bought Sin Slayers on Steam, you can get a free key for the revised version of the game - Sin Slayers: The Reign of The 8th.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=E2ebStc6-oc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Try Brand New Demo Now[/h2]

You can now experience Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th firsthand with the brand new demo available on Steam. We would be grateful for your feedback and would appreciate it if you could share your review on the demo page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861940/?curator_clanid=4777282&utm_source=SteamDB

[h3]Have you heard about the 8th Sin? We've got something extraordinary on the horizon. Keep an eye out for more details![/h3]

Our journey to independence has been long and hard, but we are happy to be here. We love making games for you and giving you the chance to redeem your sins.
